name: base1-parasite-low-health-weapon
acceptance: Fresh-inventory request switches loaded Shotgun to Machinegun while authoritative health is below45
After the request, at least two recovery route commands retain enemy aim/attack and two actual steps approach the observed kit
Observed kit disappears near the actor as server playerstate health rises, after the weapon request
Selected Machinegun is observed firing/moving and the native damage ledger confirms positive Parasite damage and its kill
No death or additional gameplay intervention; ordinary campaign movement resumes after the kill
Distinct acknowledged seeds, timescale 2, two isolated servers/clients and stable source fingerprint
scope: Prepared low starting health, visible ordinary health kit and one native Parasite. Recovery attack commands can occur during weapon animation; they are not proof that Machinegun fired during recovery. Native chosen-weapon damage is checked separately. No incoming-damage, hidden remembered kit or general campaign acceptance.
